weapons.name: Starlight Blade
weapons.description: Luminescent crystal blade with a fluid 3-hit rhythm, leaving a trail of shimmering stardust. The third strike shatters minor surrounding rocks.
weapons.upgrade_path: Upgrades at Boris's Forge: Copper → Iron → Starlight Crystal
weapons.special_effect: 3rd strike releases a stardust shockwave that shatters small rocks
weapons.materials_needed: 5 Copper Ore + 2 Coal at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Mystic Scythe
weapons.description: Enchanted scythe with a wide semi-circular sweep — dual-purposed for controlling swarms of pests and reaping patches of wheat and herbs in one swing.
weapons.special_effect: Sweeps small swarms & reaps wide farming plots
weapons.materials_needed: 8 Copper Ore + 1 Crystal Gem at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Firefly Storm Lantern
weapons.description: Ranged magical focus that fires volleys of jade sparks, repelling hostile creatures while dispelling miasma and illuminating dark tunnels.
weapons.special_effect: Knocks back monsters, illuminates deep shafts, and parts thick mist
weapons.materials_needed: 5 Iron Ore + 1 Firefly Essence at Boris's Forge

weapons.name: Colossal Tea Whisk Hammer
weapons.description: Heavy blunt warhammer that slams the ground to unleash shockwaves — pulverizing armored stone golems and mineral deposits simultaneously.
weapons.special_effect: Slam shatters monster armor and mineral nodes
weapons.materials_needed: 10 Iron Ore + 2 Crystal Gems at Boris's Forge
